findings.title: Public catalog query exposes invoices through SQL injection
findings.evidence: The public category parameter is interpolated into SQL and executed at line 26. A UNION query can read the invoices table without the invoice route's authentication check.
findings.attack_path: Unauthenticated caller → category query parameter → constructed SQL → invoices returned in the public catalog response.
findings.validation_method: In-memory Python standard-library call to the application's dispatch method using synthetic data.
findings.actual_result: A UNION payload exposed an invoice owner and amount. A separate OR payload returned unpublished product 2 and product 3; the normal books query returned only product 1.

findings.title: Download path can escape the public directory
findings.evidence: The caller-controlled name is appended to data/public without checking the resolved path before read_text() at line 40.
findings.attack_path: Unauthenticated caller → name=../internal/notes.txt → path traversal → private application file returned.
findings.validation_method: In-memory Python standard-library call to dispatch using the app's synthetic fixtures.
findings.actual_result: The traversal request returned HTTP 200; its content matched data/internal/notes.txt.

findings.title: Authenticated users can read other users' invoices
findings.evidence: The invoice lookup filters by ID but never compares the returned owner with the authenticated user before returning the row at line 36.
findings.attack_path: Alice's valid token → Bob's invoice ID in the URL → ID-only lookup → Bob's invoice returned.
findings.validation_method: In-memory Python standard-library call to dispatch using the documented synthetic tokens.
findings.actual_result: Alice's token received Bob's invoice with HTTP 200. An anonymous request received HTTP 401.

dismissed_candidates.claim: The health endpoint's eval permits attacker-controlled code execution.
dismissed_candidates.counterevidence: Line 22 evaluates the fixed literal "2 + 2". No request value reaches eval; the endpoint returned 4.

coverage_gaps: Reviewed the current clean Git snapshot, README contracts, app.py, and both data fixtures. The ChatNoir baseline helper provided leads but does not establish complete coverage.
Validation called dispatch directly; the WSGI server and HTTP transport were not exercised.
No external services, dependency audit, credential access, or broader runtime testing were used.
